# Options

<!-- Generated by `nix run .#options-doc` from the options' descriptions in nix/: edit those. -->

Every option of `nixosModules.guest` and `nixosModules.buildHost`.
[Configuration](configuration.md) explains them by topic.

## pocketnix\.buildHost\.enable

Whether to enable serving pocketnix guests’ updates as a build host\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```



## pocketnix\.buildHost\.guests



Guests allowed to build here, each pinned to one installable\.



*Type:*
attribute set of (submodule)



*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```



## pocketnix\.buildHost\.guests\.\<name>\.installable



The only thing this guest’s key builds, whatever it asks for: the
guest’s own ` updates.buildHost.installable `\.



*Type:*
string



*Example:*

```nix
"github:alice/nixos#nixosConfigurations.phone.config.system.build.toplevel"
```



## pocketnix\.buildHost\.guests\.\<name>\.publicKey



The guest’s ssh public key: that of ` pocketnix.guest.updates.buildHost.sshKey `,
by default its sshd host key (` /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub `)\.



*Type:*
string



*Example:*

```nix
"ssh-ed25519 AAAA… root@phone"
```



## pocketnix\.buildHost\.user



The account guests ssh to, as ` pocketnix.guest.updates.buildHost.host `
(` <user>@<this host> `)\. It isn’t in ` nix.settings.trusted-users `, and
its keys run nothing but the build and the copy\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"pocketnix-build"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.enable



Whether to enable the pocketnix guest side\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.package



The pocketnix package providing ` pocketnix-agent `\.



*Type:*
package



*Default:*

```nix
pocketnix.packages.${system}.pocketnix
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.agent\.listen



Addresses the agent serves\. Only vsock is limited to the app: a TCP
listener hands a shell to anyone who reaches it, so add one only for
tests\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[
  "vsock:9100"
]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "vsock:9100"
  "tcp:0.0.0.0:9100"
]
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.avf\.enable



The AVF platform: kernel, disk image, boot loader, first boot and the hvc0 console\. Off for other hypervisors, such as NixOS tests\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.files\.root



Directory the Files app and Android’s file pickers see, read-write\. Null is the user’s home\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"/home/alice/shared"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.forwards



Ports the app exposes on the phone, on 127\.0\.0\.1 unless ` lan ` is set\.



*Type:*
attribute set of (submodule)



*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```



*Example:*

```nix
{
  ssh = { guestPort = 22; hostPort = 2222; };
  mosh = { guestPort = 60001; protocol = "udp"; };
}

```



## pocketnix\.guest\.forwards\.\<name>\.guestPort



Port on the guest’s 127\.0\.0\.1\.



*Type:*
16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive)



## pocketnix\.guest\.forwards\.\<name>\.hostPort



Port the app listens on\.



*Type:*
16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive)



*Default:*

```nix
guestPort
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.forwards\.\<name>\.lan



Listen on every interface instead of 127\.0\.0\.1\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.forwards\.\<name>\.protocol



What to forward\. A UDP forward relays each phone-side client
address over a stream of its own, dropped after 2 minutes of
silence; it needs an app and agent that know UDP forwards\.



*Type:*
one of “tcp”, “udp”



*Default:*

```nix
"tcp"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.gui\.enable



Whether to enable the guest’s Wayland apps as Android windows: the pocketnix compositor
as a socket-activated user service with ` WAYLAND_DISPLAY ` set for the
user’s session, and by default PipeWire (the user in ` audio `),
xdg-desktop-portal (and with it the FileChooser integration) without
its location and wallpaper portals, an icon theme read by librsvg and
a basic font set;
CJK fonts need ` fonts.enableDefaultPackages ` or your own
\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.gui\.package



The package providing ` pocketnix-compositor `\.



*Type:*
package



*Default:*
this flake’s ` pocketnix-compositor ` for the system where it has one, else ` nix/compositor.nix ` built with this nixpkgs



## pocketnix\.guest\.gui\.appDefaults



Window settings by desktop file id without ` .desktop ` (the app list’s entry id; a window with no entry goes by its Wayland app id), over ` gui.defaults `\. Changes made in the app override both\.



*Type:*
attribute set of (submodule)



*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```



*Example:*

```nix
{
  "org.gnome.Calculator" = {
    size = "compact";
  };
}
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.gui\.appDefaults\.\<name>\.input



What a touch becomes: Wayland touch, a pointer (tap clicks, long press right-clicks) or a trackpad’s relative cursor\. Null inherits ` gui.defaults `\.



*Type:*
null or one of “touch”, “pointer”, “trackpad”



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.gui\.appDefaults\.\<name>\.size



Window scale: Android’s density (phone), about 0\.75 of it (compact) or about 0\.5 (desktop)\. Null inherits ` gui.defaults `\.



*Type:*
null or one of “phone”, “compact”, “desktop”



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.gui\.defaults\.input



What a touch becomes: Wayland touch, a pointer (tap clicks, long press right-clicks) or a trackpad’s relative cursor\.



*Type:*
one of “touch”, “pointer”, “trackpad”



*Default:*

```nix
"touch"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.gui\.defaults\.size



Window scale: Android’s density (phone), about 0\.75 of it (compact) or about 0\.5 (desktop)\.



*Type:*
one of “phone”, “compact”, “desktop”



*Default:*

```nix
"phone"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.host\.timeZone



Follow the phone’s timezone (through timedated)\. The phone’s network
and power state are always there: ` pocketnix-guest host ` prints
them, ` /run/pocketnix/host.json ` holds them, and the targets
` pocketnix-online `, ` pocketnix-unmetered `, ` pocketnix-charging ` and
` pocketnix-power-save ` are active while they hold, for units to
` bindsTo `\. Without the app, the guest counts as offline and on battery\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
config.time.timeZone == null
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.hostFolders\.mountPoint



Where the Android folders shared in the app’s settings are mounted,
each in a directory of its name: absolute, or relative to the user’s
home\. Null is ` ~/Android `\. Only the user can enter the mounts (not
even root), and they fail with EIO while the app is away\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"/mnt/android"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.integrations\.notifications



Serve ` org.freedesktop.Notifications ` on the user’s session bus
(D-Bus-activated ` pocketnix-guest notifyd `), so desktop notifications
and libnotify’s ` notify-send ` (installed) post Android notifications,
with actions\. ` pocketnix-guest notify ` works either way, also for
root and system units, which have no session bus\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.integrations\.portal



Serve xdg-desktop-portal’s FileChooser with Android’s document
pickers (` pocketnix-guest pick ` and ` save `), and make it the
FileChooser in ` xdg.portal.config.common `\. Only GUI and Flatpak
apps ask the portal\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
config.xdg.portal.enable
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.integrations\.xdgOpen



Put an ` xdg-open ` on PATH (and default ` $BROWSER ` to it) that opens
URLs, and files under ` files.root `, on Android; and make Android the
default (` xdg.mime.defaultApplications `) for web, mail, phone and map
links and a few common file types, so ` gio open ` and GLib/Qt
programs open there too\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.power\.wakeLocks\.enable



Keep the phone out of deep sleep while anything in the guest holds a
logind sleep or idle inhibitor (` systemd-inhibit --what=sleep … `),
as the app’s notification then says\. The app has a setting to
refuse\. Enables polkit, and lets ` pocketnix.guest.user ` take such
inhibitors from the app’s tabs, which have no logind session\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
true
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.power\.wakeLocks\.ignore



Inhibitors whose *who* is one of these never keep the phone awake: daemons that hold one for good\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "ModemManager"
]
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.share\.command



Run (by /bin/sh, as ` pocketnix.guest.user `) on each delivered file, its path the last argument\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"notify-send shared"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.share\.directory



Where Android’s share sheet drops text and files: absolute, or relative to the user’s home\. Null is ` ~/Inbox `\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"Downloads"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.defaultProfile



Profile a new tab runs\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"shell"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.extraKeys



Rows of keys above the keyboard, in Termux’s extra-keys vocabulary\.



*Type:*
list of list of ((submodule) or string convertible to it)



*Default:*

```nix
[
  [
    "ESC"
    {
      key = "/";
      popup = "\\";
    }
    {
      key = "-";
      popup = "|";
    }
    "HOME"
    "UP"
    "END"
    "PGUP"
  ]
  [
    "TAB"
    "CTRL"
    "ALT"
    "LEFT"
    "DOWN"
    "RIGHT"
    "PGDN"
  ]
]
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.extraKeys\.\*\.\*\.key



Termux extra-keys name (ESC, TAB, CTRL, ALT, UP, PGUP, F1, …) or a literal character\.



*Type:*
string



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.extraKeys\.\*\.\*\.label



Text shown on the button instead of the key’s name\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.extraKeys\.\*\.\*\.popup



Key sent on a swipe up from this one\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.historyFile



Shell history the command palette offers\. Null reads the login
shell’s default file (bash, zsh or fish); zsh files are recognized
by “zsh” in their name, fish files by ending in ` fish_history `\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"/home/alice/.local/share/zsh/history"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.profiles



Kinds of terminal tab; each runs through the user’s login shell\.



*Type:*
attribute set of (submodule)



*Default:*

```nix
{
  shell = { };
}
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.profiles\.\<name>\.command



Command the tab runs (` $SHELL -l -c `); null runs the login shell itself\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"tmux new-session -A -s main"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.snippets



Command-palette entries, listed above the shell history\. A string is the command\.



*Type:*
attribute set of ((submodule) or string convertible to it)



*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```



*Example:*

```nix
{
  "Attach zellij" = {
    command = "zellij attach --create main";
    submit = true;
  };
  "Follow the journal" = "journalctl -f";
}
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.snippets\.\<name>\.command



Text typed into the tab\.



*Type:*
string



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.snippets\.\<name>\.submit



Press Enter after typing the command\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.theme\.colors



Terminal colors by Termux property name: foreground, background, cursor, color0 to color15\.



*Type:*
attribute set of string matching the pattern \#\[0-9a-fA-F]{6}



*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```



*Example:*

```nix
{
  background = "#1e1e2e";
  color1 = "#f38ba8";
  foreground = "#cdd6f4";
}
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.theme\.font



TTF or OTF file the terminal renders with\.



*Type:*
null or absolute path



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"${pkgs.jetbrains-mono}/share/fonts/truetype/JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.theme\.fontFamily



A font by family, found in its package with fontconfig; for ` font ` when you think in families\.



*Type:*
null or (submodule)



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
{ package = pkgs.nerd-fonts.jetbrains-mono; family = "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono"; }
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.theme\.fontFamily\.package



Package holding the family’s files\.



*Type:*
package



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.theme\.fontFamily\.family



fontconfig family name\.



*Type:*
string



## pocketnix\.guest\.terminal\.theme\.fontFamily\.style



fontconfig style\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"Regular"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.updates\.buildHost\.flake



Flake whose ` nixosConfigurations.<hostName> ` is this system; the build host refreshes it on every check\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"github:alice/nixos"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.updates\.buildHost\.host



ssh destination of a build host: a machine with Nix that evaluates
and builds this system, which the guest then copies (or
substitutes, when the host pushes to a cache the guest uses)\.
Port and the like belong in ` programs.ssh.extraConfig `, and its
host key in ` programs.ssh.knownHosts `: the agent never prompts\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"alice@desktop"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.updates\.buildHost\.installable



What the build host builds (` nix build --refresh <installable> `)\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
"${flake}#nixosConfigurations.${networking.hostName}.config.system.build.toplevel"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.updates\.buildHost\.sshKey



Identity the agent (as root) uses for the build host; null leaves it to ssh\. The build host’s user must trust its public key\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
"/etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.updates\.checkInterval



How often the agent checks for a newer system in the background (a Go duration); null checks only when asked in the app\.



*Type:*
null or string matching the pattern 0|((\[0-9]+(\\\.\[0-9]\*)?|\\\.\[0-9]+)(ns|us|µs|μs|ms|s|m|h))+



*Default:*

```nix
"6h"
```



*Example:*

```nix
"30m"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.updates\.published\.url



URL whose body is this system’s toplevel store path, which CI
publishes after pushing the closure to a binary cache the guest
trusts\. The guest only substitutes it\. With a build host too, this
is the fallback while the build host can’t be reached\.



*Type:*
null or string matching the pattern https://\.+



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"https://ci.example.com/phone/toplevel"
```



## pocketnix\.guest\.user



User that the app’s terminal tabs run as, and that the hvc0 console logs in\.



*Type:*
string



*Default:*

```nix
"root"
```



*Example:*

```nix
"alice"
```
